description_en: Subscribes to an API product for a specified HiMarket Consumer. The path parameter specifies the consumer ID, the request body specifies the ID of the API product to subscribe to, and the response returns the subscription ID, API product ID and name, API product type, consumer ID and name, and subscription status
description_zh: 在指定的 HiMarket Consumer 上订阅一个 API 产品：路径参数给出消费者 ID，请求体给出要订阅的 API 产品 ID，调用后返回该订阅记录的订阅 ID、API 产品 ID 与名称、API 产品类型、消费者 ID 与名称以及订阅状态
kebab_example: aliyun apig subscribe-product --consumer-id cs-xxxxxxxxxxxx --product-id product-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubscribeProduct

parameters.help_en: The consumer ID. This parameter specifies the HiMarket Consumer for which to subscribe to an API product. This operation authenticates the request based on the consumer. After this operation creates the subscription record, you can call UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct to cancel the subscription or call ApproveProductSubscription to approve the subscription
parameters.help_zh: 消费者 ID，指定要为哪个 HiMarket Consumer 订阅 API 产品。本接口按该消费者维度鉴权，订阅记录建立后可由 UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct 取消、由 ApproveProductSubscription 审批
parameters.name: consumer_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product to subscribe to. This is the primary ID of the Product resource. You can obtain this ID from the productId field of a list item returned by ListProducts
parameters.help_zh: 要订阅的 API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，可由查询API产品列表（ListProducts）返回的列表项 productId 获得
parameters.name: product_id

consumerId.description_en: The ID of the consumer to which the subscription belongs. This is the same as the consumerId path parameter in the request and refers to the same consumer as the consumerName returned at the same level
consumerId.description_zh: 订阅所属消费者的 ID，与请求的路径参数 consumerId 为同一标识，并与同层返回的 consumerName 指向同一个消费者

consumerName.description_en: The name of the consumer to which the subscription belongs. This consumer is the same as the consumerId returned at the same level
consumerName.description_zh: 订阅所属消费者的名称，与同层返回的 consumerId 指向同一个消费者

productId.description_en: The ID of the subscribed API product. This is the primary ID of the Product resource and is the same as the productId specified in the request body
productId.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，与请求体中传入的 productId 为同一标识

productName.description_en: The name of the subscribed API product. This is the Name property of the Product resource
productName.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品名称，即 API 产品资源 Product 的 Name 属性

productType.description_en: The type of the subscribed API product. The value set is not declared in this operation definition. The response parameter with the same name in the related ListProductSubscriptions operation is annotated with @enums. Valid values: REST_API, HTTP_API, MCP_SERVER, AGENT_API, and MODEL_API
productType.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品类型。取值集合未在本篇接口定义中声明；同族接口 ListProductSubscriptions 的同名出参挂了 @enums，其枚举为 REST_API、HTTP_API、MCP_SERVER、AGENT_API、MODEL_API

status.description_en: The subscription status. Valid values: PENDING and APPROVED. The value set is declared in the enum of the status request parameter of the related ListProductSubscriptions operation. This response parameter is not annotated with @enums
status.description_zh: 订阅状态。取值：PENDING、APPROVED（该取值集合声明在同族接口 ListProductSubscriptions 入参 status 的枚举上，本篇出参未挂 @enums）

subscriptionId.description_en: The subscription ID, which identifies the API product subscription record corresponding to this subscription. You can use this ID to call UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct to cancel the subscription or call ApproveProductSubscription to approve the subscription. Both operations identify the record by using /himarket/v1/consumers/{consumerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}
subscriptionId.description_zh: 订阅 ID，标识本次订阅对应的 API 产品订阅记录。可用于 UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct 取消该订阅、ApproveProductSubscription 审批该订阅，二者均以 /himarket/v1/consumers/{consumerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId} 定位该记录

v1_parameters.help_en: The consumer ID. This parameter specifies the HiMarket Consumer for which to subscribe to an API product. This operation authenticates the request based on the consumer. After this operation creates the subscription record, you can call UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct to cancel the subscription or call ApproveProductSubscription to approve the subscription
v1_parameters.help_zh: 消费者 ID，指定要为哪个 HiMarket Consumer 订阅 API 产品。本接口按该消费者维度鉴权，订阅记录建立后可由 UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct 取消、由 ApproveProductSubscription 审批
v1_parameters.name: consumerId
